invariants.rationale: activeModule should typically identify the module for the job and is expected to be non-null.
activityDescription is expected to describe the status or activity and be non-null.
The method is non-static and operating on an instance, so 'this' must not be null.
activeModule is declared as a String and should always be a String instance.
activityDescription is declared as a String and should always be a String instance.
